questions.question: A savings fund in which both, the employer and the employee contribute regularly in the interest of the employee is known as:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. __Provident Fund__.**

__
 
• **Provident Fund__** is an amount of money consisting of regular payments by an employee and an employer over a period of time that the employee receives when they leave a company or retire.
 
• Employees' Provident Fund Organisation **(EPFO)** is the organisation which regulates the provident fund of all the workers employed in the Organised sector in India.
 
• A **mutual fund **is a company that pools money from many investors and invests the money in securities such as stocks, bonds, and short-term debt. 
 
• A **balanced fund** is a mutual fund that contains a stock component, a bond component and sometimes a money market component in a single portfolio.
 
• An **Index Fund** today is a source of investment for investors looking at the long term, less risky form of investment.

questions.question: Burzahom, the neolithic site, is located in ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. __Jammu and Kashmir.__**

 
• The "Burzahom" Neolithic site is located in the Kashmir Valley of the Indian Union 
territory of **Jammu and Kashmir,** in the district of Srinagar**.**
 
• The site of Burzahom is a unique comprehensive storyteller of life between 3000 BCE to 1000 BCE.
 
• The Burzahom site revealed the transition from the subterranean and ground-level housing features of the Neolithic people to the mudbrick structures of the Megalithic people. The site was Excavated in 1939.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers originates from Mahabaleshwar?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Krishna__.**

 
• The **Krishna** River is a peninsular river which rises from a spring near** Mahabaleshwar **and flows for about **1400 km** and reaches the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
• The Tungabhadra, the Koyana, the Ghatprabha, the Musi and the Bhima are some of its **tributaries**.
 
• Its **drainage basin** is shared by Maharashtra, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Some of the other major peninsular rivers which flow eastwards and drain into the Bay of Bengal are the Mahanadi, the Godavari, the Krishna and the Kaveri.

Please go through the given link for more Information on Krishna river. : http://www.cpreecenvis.nic.in/Database/River_Krishna_924.aspx

questions.question: Which of the followings, is NOT a Peninsular river?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e. __Alaknanda__.**

__
 
• The **Alaknanda**__ river flowing in Uttarakhand is a Himalayan river.
 
• It is one of the two headstreams of the river Ganga, the other being **Bhagirathi river.**
 
• The source of the Alaknanda River is the confluence of the** Satopanth glacier **and the** Bhagirathi Garak glacier.**
 
• The length of the river is 190 km and the area of the drainage basin is 10882 km².
 
• It is joined by the** Bhagirathi at Devaprayag **in Uttarakhand.
 
• The other major tributaries of the Ganga in Uttarakhand are Dhauli Ganga, Rishi Ganga, Bal Ganga, Bhilangana, Mandakini and Pindar.

questions.question: With reference to Remote Sensing Technology, what does LIDAR stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e. __Light Detection and Ranging.__**

 
• LIDAR stands for **Light Detection and Ranging.**
 
• It is a remote sensing method that uses light in the form of a pulsed laser from the satellites or any aerial vehicle to measure ranges (variable distances) to the Earth.
 
• It is used in a wide range of land assessment, management and planning efforts, including hazard assessment (including lava flows, landslides, tsunamis, and floods), forestry, agriculture, geologic mapping, and watershed and river surveys.

Note: Please go through the following link for more information on the answer: https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/lidar.html

questions.question: Who among the following was appointed as the first Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. __M. Ananthasayanam Ayyangar.__**

__
 
• **M. Ananthasayanam Ayyangar**__ served as the First Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
 
• He was born on 4 February 1891 at Tiruchanur near the spiritual town of Tirupati in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• After obtaining his B.A. degree from the Pachaiyappa's College, Madras, he earned a degree in Law from the Madras Law College in 1913
 
• He began his career as a Mathematics teacher in 1912. In 1915 he ventured into the legal profession- Within a short period, he established himself as a professional lawyer and, with his unusual ability to memorise cases, soon earned the reputation of being a 'walking digest of case laws'.
 
• Through a public life spanning over six decades as a lawyer, as a social activist and freedom fighter, as an outstanding parliamentarian and Speaker and as a distinguished scholar, Ayyangar left an indelible imprint of his personality in every area he chose to tread on in life.

**Note: Please go through the following link for more information on the answer: https://speakerloksabha.nic.in/frmspeaker.asp**
